title: Catchplate Response v2 Nested Authority Artifact

payloadSha256.$comment: SHA-256 over RFC 8785 JCS of payload. The verifier MUST reconstruct generation, physical process, service role, logical role, key material, authority scope, operation, operation ID, attempt, revision, fence, and payload and reject any mismatch between body and authentication.

scopeSha256.$comment: SHA-256 over RFC 8785 JCS of this authority scope with scopeSha256 omitted. The verifier MUST require the enclosing operation to be present in allowedOperations and reconstruct every duplicated identity field from the authenticated provider generation.

durableCanonicalResultSha256.$comment: SHA-256 over the durable PREPARE result before the release-preparation artifact, signed preparation receipt, and outer operation result are added. This exclusion prevents a receipt self-reference.
